title: MIF conformance profile — Level 1 (Core)
description: Level 1 = the MIF core required fields (@context, @type, a urn:mif:<uuid> @id, conceptType or the deprecated memoryType, content, created). No overlay beyond the base schema. MIF 1.4.0+ Level 1 also requires an OKF bundle of .md concept files, which a per-ADR check cannot see.
